question: Is INT8 even faster than FP16 at ~193k params / 960x540?
answer: No. QDQ INT8 is slower than FP16 on both the GN smoke graph and the no-GN smoke_int8 graph.

nogn_smoke_int8_192595.note: Timing only. This graph missed +0.25. Do not cite these ms as a quality result.

lesson: At this size the QDQ / INT8 path does not beat FP16. The BN-fold (or any INT8) effort is not the next latency lever. Drop qdq_on_failed_nogn from do_not for timing; keep it for quality claims. Storm + more combat data are the live levers.
